about: The innovators Trip 2050 shows between the pictures, in the order of their year. file is the portrait's name on Wikimedia Commons; tools/fetch_portraits.py downloads it, cuts it to the frame in crop (centre x, centre y, height, as parts of the original) and writes CREDITS.md. line is what they did in that year.

people.name: Archimedes
people.line: Worked out the lever and why things float

people.name: Leonardo da Vinci
people.line: Drew flying machines four centuries before the first flight

people.name: Galileo Galilei
people.line: Turned a telescope to the sky and found the moons of Jupiter

people.name: Isaac Newton
people.line: Wrote down the laws of motion and gravity

people.name: Michael Faraday
people.line: Turned motion into electricity

people.name: Ada Lovelace
people.line: Published the first program, for a computer that was never built

people.name: Jules Verne
people.line: Sent three men from Florida to the Moon, in a novel

people.name: Louis Pasteur
people.line: Gave the first rabies vaccine to a person

people.name: Nikola Tesla
people.line: Patented the alternating-current motor

people.name: Konstantin Tsiolkovsky
people.line: Published the rocket equation

people.name: Wilbur & Orville Wright
people.line: Flew the first powered aeroplane, for 12 seconds

people.name: Marie Curie
people.line: Won a second Nobel Prize, in a second science

people.name: Albert Einstein
people.line: Showed that gravity is the curve of space and time

people.name: Robert Goddard
people.line: Launched the first liquid-fuel rocket

people.name: Alan Turing
people.line: Described a machine that can compute anything computable

people.name: Hedy Lamarr
people.line: Patented frequency hopping, the idea under Wi-Fi and Bluetooth

people.name: Claude Shannon
people.line: Founded information theory and named the bit

people.name: Grace Hopper
people.line: Built the first compiler

people.name: Katherine Johnson
people.line: Checked by hand the orbit that carried John Glenn

people.name: Margaret Hamilton
people.line: Led the software that landed Apollo on the Moon

people.name: Tu Youyou
people.line: Isolated artemisinin, the malaria drug

people.name: Tim Berners-Lee
people.line: Proposed the World Wide Web

people.name: Steve Jobs
people.line: Put the internet in a pocket

people.name: Jennifer Doudna
people.line: Showed that CRISPR can edit genes
